description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Regulation as the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour) No. 11 of 2022 Come into Operation on 04.02.2023.
reasoning: This gazette contains new regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes legal requirements for maritime labor, including applicability rules, minimum age requirements, and working conditions for seafarers. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
